description: Use this when an owner wants a coaching brain for their place, so members train with the gym's own coach in the Phorme app. Confirm with the owner first, and set confirmation to true only after they said yes. In one step it makes a brain from the place's name, line and classes, gives it a starting program from the Phorme library, publishes it and puts the place's members under it, the same as the console's one-click start. The owner can change it in the builder after. Free on the free listing too. It needs a connected Phorme account that owns the place.

confirmation.description: Set to true only after the owner said yes to starting a coaching brain for this place.

days_per_week.description: Training days a week the starting program is built for. Default 3.

place_id.description: The place_id of one of the owner's places, from get_gym_report or create_or_claim_place.

name: start_gym_brain

open.description: Publish checks still open, when it stayed a draft.

title: Start my gym's coaching brain
